# Mysaa Rituals

> Mysaa Rituals is an India-based handcrafted candle and gifting brand creating soy wax candles, Indian fragrance candles, gift hampers, wedding return gifts, festive gifting and personalised candle rituals.

## Primary website
- https://mysaarituals.github.io/mysaa_website/

## Product catalogue
- https://mysaarituals.github.io/mysaa_website/#/catalogue

## Crawlable product pages
Each product has a dedicated crawlable page under `/products/<product-slug>/`, with price, format, fragrance notes, burn time, care instructions, delivery guidance, shipping policy and returns policy.

## Gifting and customisation
Mysaa Rituals offers festival gifting, wedding and return gifts, birthdays, just-because gifting, custom mould candles and personalised candle requests.

## Policies
Shipping cost is separate and shared during payment. Products cannot be returned unless the wrong product or a defective product is received.
